title: Control Flow [switch]
description:
## switch
When you have many conditions on the same value, use `switch` instead of chaining `else if`:

```qc
switch (x) {
    case 1:
        qout("One");
        break;
    case 2:
        qout("Two");
        break;
    default:
        qout("Other");
}
```

- Each `case` checks a value
- `break` stops fallthrough
- `default` catches everything else


---
## Assignment:
TechQ maps qubit states. Given `state`:
- 0 -> print `Ground`
- 1 -> print `Excited`
- 2 -> print `Superposition`
- anything else -> print `Unknown`
